column7: 2026-11-05: JSONStorage sort_keys-by-default was tried and backed out (user's call, release cutting). Plain setdefault('sort_keys', True) crashes with TypeError on mixed int/str dict keys (e.g. hits {200:..., 'other':...} from ingest job). If revisited: stringify keys recursively before sorting, add test with that doc shape. Not implemented.

2026-11-05: JSONStorage sort_keys default re-implemented (user asked again): setdefault('sort_keys', True) plus _stringify_keys in write() to avoid TypeError on mixed int/str keys; tests added incl. {200:..,'other':..}. Known edge: keys 1 and '1' in same dict collide after stringify (data loss) - not handled.
